presenter.stage: linear-gradient(rgba(20,20,20,.06) 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0/60px 60px, linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(20,20,20,.06) 1px, transparent 1px) 0 0/60px 60px, radial-gradient(60% 70% at 50% 40%, #FFFFFF, #E9E5DC)
